description: This is a Java source file defining the ShoppingCartServices class, which provides various service methods for manipulating shopping cart data within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for assigning items to shipment groups, setting shipping and payment options, loading carts from orders, quotes, or shopping lists, and retrieving cart data.

classes.name: ShoppingCartServices
classes.description: A utility class providing various static service methods for managing shopping cart and order related data in the OFBiz e-commerce framework.

methods.name: assignItemShipGroup
methods.description: Assigns or moves a shopping cart item to a different shipment group within the shopping cart.

methods.name: setShippingOptions
methods.description: Sets shipping contact, method, instructions, gift message, and related options for a specific shipment group in the shopping cart.

methods.name: setPaymentOptions
methods.description: Placeholder for setting payment options; currently returns a not implemented error.

methods.name: setOtherOptions
methods.description: Sets additional options such as order emails and PO number in the shopping cart.

methods.name: loadCartFromOrder
methods.description: Loads a shopping cart object based on an existing order, including its items, adjustments, contact info, and shipment groups.

methods.name: loadCartFromQuote
methods.description: Creates a shopping cart from a quote, transferring quotes items, attributes, roles, and adjustments.

methods.name: loadCartFromShoppingList
methods.description: Builds a shopping cart from a shopping list, optionally incorporating modified prices.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Provides summary data about the shopping cart, such as totals, taxes, shipping, and formatted display info.

methods.name: getShoppingCartItemIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of the first cart item matching a specified productId.

methods.name: resetShipGroupItems
methods.description: Clears shipment grouping information from all items in the cart, resetting shipment groups.

methods.name: prepareVendorShipGroups
methods.description: Prepares shipment groups based on vendor info, resetting current groupings.
